title: 8 Nifty stocks delivered negative returns over 5 years. Do you own any?
summary: Over the past five years, eight Nifty stocks have recorded disappointing returns, causing significant impacts on investors' portfolios. Notably, Infosys and TCS saw steep declines of approximately 37% and 36%, respectively. Hindustan Unilever and Asian Paints also struggled, facing losses around 28% and nearly 29%. Other affected companies included HDFC Life and Reliance Industries with negative returns of 22% and 13%. With changing market conditions, investors must re-evaluate their strategies.
